payload.task: self_diffusion of liquid Li at 800 K (thermostat equilibration, then NVE velocity-Verlet production with energy-drift check)
payload.reason: Premise is fine: Li melts at 453.7 K, so 800 K is well inside the liquid range, and D is measurable by MSD in ps-scale NVE MD. The run did not finish within the compute and budget available. Setup: ASE 3.29 + MACE-MP-0 medium (mace-torch 0.3.15), dt 1 fs. Melt at 1500 K (Langevin), then NPTBerendsen at 800 K / 0 bar for the model density, then Langevin NVT 800 K, then 15 ps VelocityVerlet NVE; D from the MSD slope, block-averaged uncertainty. On this shared GB10 GPU it ran at about 0.1-0.2 s/step even with 128 atoms in float32 (a first 250-atom float64 attempt was abandoned for the same reason). After ~20 min of CPU time the melt+NPT stages had not finished, so no NVE trajectory, energy drift or D exists. Only validation completed: MACE-MP-0 static bcc Li lattice constant a0 = 3.500 A. Not compared against a measured value here; it is not in tier1.json, which has no Li records. Measured reference to use for validation: Murday & Cotts, J. Chem. Phys. 48, 4938 (1968), NMR self-diffusion of liquid Li; its numbers were not retrieved, so none are quoted. To retry: use a batched GPU integrator (nvalchemi dynamics), or a less loaded GPU, at about 128-250 atoms, >=20 ps NVE, plus a Yeh-Hummer finite-size note. No value is reported.
